website.WhatIsEsim.content.paragraph1: An eSIM is an embedded subscriber identity module — essentially, a built-in chip in your phone. It does everything a traditional SIM would do, but without having to slot a tiny card into your phone. Additionally, an eSIM allows you to use several carriers and phone numbers at once, which is super convenient.
website.NewSimfinDes.what_is_esim.WhatIsEsim.Esi: Manual or automatic (plan activates at your destination)

whatIsEsim.pageMeta: Learn what an eSIM is, how it works, and why it's the future of mobile connectivity for travelers.
whatIsEsim.heroSubtitle: An eSIM is a digital SIM embedded in your device. It lets you connect to mobile networks without a physical SIM card — just download a plan and go.
whatIsEsim.howWorksStep1: Your device has a tiny chip built in that acts as a SIM card.
whatIsEsim.howWorksStep2: Instead of inserting a physical card, you download a carrier profile digitally.
whatIsEsim.howWorksStep3: The eSIM profile connects you to local networks in your destination.
whatIsEsim.howWorksStep4: You can store multiple profiles and switch between them anytime.
whatIsEsim.benefitSetupDesc: No need to visit a store or wait for delivery. Download and activate in minutes.
whatIsEsim.benefitGlobalDesc: Connect in 200+ destinations worldwide without swapping SIM cards.
whatIsEsim.benefitProfilesDesc: Store several eSIM profiles on one device — perfect for frequent travelers.
whatIsEsim.benefitSecureDesc: eSIMs can't be physically removed, stolen, or lost. Built-in security.
whatIsEsim.benefitEcoDesc: No plastic SIM cards, no packaging waste. Better for the planet.
whatIsEsim.benefitDualDesc: Keep your regular number active while using an eSIM for data abroad.
whatIsEsim.faq1A: An eSIM (embedded SIM) is a digital SIM built into your device. Instead of inserting a physical SIM card, you download a data plan digitally. It works just like a regular SIM but without the physical card.
whatIsEsim.faq2Q: How is an eSIM different from a physical SIM?
whatIsEsim.faq2A: A physical SIM is a small card you insert into your phone. An eSIM is embedded in your device and can be programmed with different carrier profiles digitally. You can switch plans without swapping cards.
whatIsEsim.faq3A: Most phones released after 2018 support eSIM, including iPhone XR and later, Samsung Galaxy S20 and later, Google Pixel 3 and later, and many more. Check our Supported Devices page for a full list.
whatIsEsim.faq4Q: Can I keep my regular phone number with an eSIM?
whatIsEsim.faq4A: Yes! You can use your eSIM for data while keeping your physical SIM for calls and texts with your regular number. This dual-SIM setup is perfect for travelers.
whatIsEsim.faq5Q: How do I install an eSIM?
whatIsEsim.faq5A: It's simple: purchase an eSIM plan, scan the QR code provided, and follow your phone's setup instructions. Most installations take under 5 minutes.
whatIsEsim.faq6Q: Is an eSIM as reliable as a physical SIM?
whatIsEsim.faq6A: Yes, eSIMs use the same cellular networks as physical SIMs. The only difference is how the SIM profile is delivered — digitally instead of on a physical card.
whatIsEsim.ctaDesc: Browse our affordable plans and get connected in minutes — no physical SIM card needed.
